criteria.one: No legible intended response or payoff.
criteria.three: Recognizable feeling, amusement or curiosity, but generic or dependent on inferred backstory.
criteria.five: A specific visible event, choice or payoff earns the intended response for this lane.

criteria.one: Needs unplanned explanation or more time than available.
criteria.three: Selected format is understandable with one possible ambiguity to test.
criteria.five: Progression and payoff read without external explanation; declared text-led formats include their intended on-screen text.

criteria.one: No meaningful development or an arbitrary trick.
criteria.three: A coherent reveal, comic development, recognition or poetic progression.
criteria.five: An earned payoff deepens or changes the opening through the selected lane; a surprise twist is not mandatory.

criteria.one: Near-copy of a known clip or a stock tearjerker.
criteria.three: Familiar mechanism with specific fresh details.
criteria.five: Distinctive visual expression without relying on novelty alone.

criteria.one: Uncontrolled crowd, complex contact or several transformations.
criteria.three: One difficult effect/contact that can be isolated or simplified.
criteria.five: One location, simple visible action, stable identities and controllable framing.

criteria.one: Requires several high-cost takes with little asset reuse.
criteria.three: Two or three independently repairable shots.
criteria.five: One or two simple shots, reusable anchors, inexpensive animatic first.

criteria.one: Meaning requires audio or rescue explanation; intended format text is missing or unreadable.
criteria.three: Core intended payoff reads muted in the declared format; nuance may need sound.
criteria.five: Selected lane's progression/payoff reads muted: without text for visual-first, with readable intended on-screen text for explicitly text-led work.

rankingPolicy: Rank eligible ideas by editorial score, then ID. Keep user rating and decision separate; never invent user feedback or treat editorial score as probability.
comprehensionPolicy: Default visual-first; explanatory rescue captions do not fix confused action. Explicit comprehensionMode:text-led requires original textPlan copy, placement, readabilityTest and renderStage. silent-legible-core means muted comprehension WITH intended format text for that route, tested for phone-size contrast, duration and composition. The assembler does not render text.
shortlistPolicy: Top six is only a provisional discussion queue. User can select, reject or request a rewrite regardless of score.
